title: Eatventure: Cooking Restaurant
meta_description: Manage a food tycoon, build and level up your idle cooking restaurant business.
full_description: Be an idle restaurant tycoon manager in one of the most cooking simulation games in Eatventure: Cooking Restaurant!In this fast food simulator game, you need to have the most delicious food, great staff and the fastest delivery. Become a rich tycoon with your managing business skills.Learn more about Eatventure: Cooking Restaurant.Let's play, then open new restaurants with new cooking dishes, deliver them as fast as you can, remember that you can always come back to your old restaurants and enjoy this business simulator adventure with all your franchises. This restaurant games are fun, but this delivery tycoon will become your favorite.This simulator game is unique, upgrade to maximize your restaurant business, earn more money and invest your cash in the different stations of your restaurant to become a tycoon! Level up! Upgrade your restaurant and open new franchises with new dishes, easy and simple. This is not a classic clicker game, this is a new idle tycoon adventure, an cooking restaurant simulator.HOW TO BECOME A SUCCESSFUL IDLE RESTAURANT TYCOON MANAGER?- Take orders, cooking and deliver to customers- Establish the best staff for each section- Upgrade your restaurant to become a millionaire in this idle gameFEATURES:- Beautiful and cute 2D graphics- 100% free game- Fun and addictive gameplay- Easy controls- For kids and adults- Game for girls and boys- Unlock many kinds of food and restaurants- Upgrade your staff and restaurantsExpand your restaurants, automate your business and find the right strategy in order to maximize your income! Eatventure: Cooking Restaurant is a money game where you simulate the management of different kinds of restaurants. Use your income to buy new stations in order to start selling more kinds of foods!
